title: Old Debts
summary: Brannoc, the Redhand deserter you freed in Wickham Keep, says Garrow's sergeants think he owes them. He owes them nothing, and he'd like that settled before it follows him out of the Keep.

steps.journal: Defeat three Redhand sergeants in Wickham Keep. They are the Redhand's elites and lead every fifth wave; Brannoc knows them by their shouting.

ready: Tell Brannoc it's done: tap his party card, then Talk.
done: You defeated the three sergeants who kept Brannoc's chain oiled. He said nothing, and stood up straighter.
